text:
Sam: opened a docs PR for consumption heuristics around rate limits/quotas and how billing interacts with slab tiers — https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4821
Priya: nice. quick thing — can we add an example for long-lived streaming connections (client holds socket open + intermittent requests)?
Sam: good call. added a short JS snippet demonstrating incremental token counts and when meter events fire. see the PR diff (lines ~120-140)
Marta: saw the JS snippet, lgtm, but we need a Python async example for the SDK users. most of our customers using desktop agents prefer python examples
Sam: adding Python async now. planning to show both header + example of `x-meter-usage` in response headers
Diego: FYI backend note: bursts are consumed from `burst_credits` up to 5k tokens/min for accounts with burst enabled. please include the header name `x-burst-remaining` in examples so customers can surface it
Sam: added a short API response sample:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
x-meter-usage: 2300
x-burst-remaining: 2700
{ "data": ... }
```
Priya: also can we clarify rounding rules? generation billed per 1 token, embeddings billed per 100 tokens — some customers confused during migration
Diego: correct. added a note under "billing & rounding" and a one-row table explaining rounding units
Marta: small SDK nit: current js snippet uses `client.generate` which is deprecated; should be `client.responses.create`. I'll submit a tiny patch to the PR
Sam: thanks, fixed both JS + Python snippets and pushed. also updated the sample dashboard panel to use the new panel id `metering_consumption_v2`
Priya: the dashboard screenshot link was broken earlier — I updated it to the updated assets bucket path. can you confirm the image renders in the staging site?
Sam: confirmed on staging, screenshot renders. added alt text and caption explaining the panel breakdown by slab tier
Alex (legal): quick flag on "free tier" wording — we should avoid guaranteeing indefinite free usage. suggested language: "Free usage applies to new accounts for the first 90 days or up to X tokens, whichever comes first." Applied patch in the PR comments
Sam: applied Alex's language. pinging @Priya for final copy check
Priya: looks good, one micro copy tweak on the CTA. changed "Contact sales for dedicated capacity" -> "Contact sales to discuss Dedicated capacity"
Sam: updated. Also added a small troubleshooting section for customers seeing unexpected spikes: points to `x-meter-usage` header, dashboard panel, and a link to the rate limit FAQ
docs-bot: PR checks: lint ✅ | link-checker: found 1 broken link -> fixed by Sam | staging-preview available: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/pr/4821
Marta: CI test failing on an unrelated formatting rule in docs linter, will push a fix in 5m
Priya: no blockers from product side, approve once CI is green. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Diego: ack from infra side — the backend behavior in the notes matches prod telemetry we saw last week
Sam: merging after Marta's CI fix — will post release note blurb in #announcements once live. thanks all
Marta: pushed formatting fix, CI green now
Sam: merged. closing the loop: release note queued, and created a small follow-up issue to add a worked example for multi-tenant billing edge cases
Priya: perfect. thanks team! :tada:
